settings.title: Integration settings and modes
settings.description: Manage offline modes and resilience policy. A custom API base URL changes the trusted endpoint for its role, but never forwards OAuth, Passport track IDs, or expanded cookie scopes to an untrusted origin. YAML ssl: false still disables TLS certificate verification, including for diagnostic MiTM proxies; cookies, tokens, and commands are then exposed to the proxy.

data.enable_diagnostic_sensors: Enable connectivity and status diagnostic sensors

data_description.quasar_base_url: HTTPS URL for Quasar API; path prefix is preserved. No userinfo, query, or fragment. Current URL: {current_quasar}. Leave empty to clear override.
data_description.account_base_url: HTTPS URL for account endpoints; path prefix is preserved. No userinfo, query, or fragment. Current URL: {current_account}. Leave empty to clear override.
data_description.passport_base_url: HTTPS URL for Passport; path prefix is preserved. Credentials are never sent to a foreign origin. Current URL: {current_passport}. Leave empty to clear override.
data_description.mobileproxy_base_url: HTTPS URL for MobileProxy; current URL: {current_mobileproxy}. Leave empty to clear override.
data_description.glagol_base_url: HTTPS URL for Glagol token API; current URL: {current_glagol}. Leave empty to clear override.
data_description.rpc_base_url: HTTPS URL for RPC; current URL: {current_rpc}. Leave empty to clear override.
data_description.cookie_storage_endpoints: Non-empty JSON array of url/validator objects (status_ok or uid_in_storage); current value: {current_cookie}. Leave empty to clear override.
data_description.csrf_endpoints: Non-empty JSON array of HTTPS URLs; current value: {current_csrf}. Leave empty to clear override.
